# Application bundle fixtures

Fixtures for `tests/appbundle.rs` and `web/tests/appbundle.test.mjs`.
`generate.sh` rebuilds them. The PyInstaller archives and .NET single-file
bundles in the tests have no committed fixture: PyInstaller is not
installed here, and a .NET bundle needs Microsoft's apphost binary, so the
tests build both from the documented layouts (see `docs/appbundle.md`).

## Contents

`sample.asar` is an Electron ASAR archive packed from this tree:

| Path | Contents | In the archive |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bin/run.sh` | `#!/bin/sh` and `exit 0` (17 B), mode 755 | offset 0, `executable: true` |
| `index.js` | one line of JavaScript (50 B) | offset 17 |
| `native/aarch64.node` | `tests/fixtures/archives/payload.elf` (256 B, an AArch64 ELF64 header and filler) | offset 67 |
| `native/x86_64.node` | `tests/fixtures/compressed/payload.elf` (256 B, an x86-64 ELF64 header and filler) | offset 323 |
| `assets/readme.txt` | one line of text (18 B) | `unpacked: true` (not in the archive) |
| `lib/main.js` | symbolic link to `../index.js` | `link: "index.js"` |

`asar` writes `header_size` 1376 (a 1368-byte JSON string padded to 1372
bytes, after the 4-byte string length), so file data starts at 1384. Every
file entry carries an `integrity` object: SHA-256 of the whole file,
`blockSize` 4194304 and one block hash. The `.node` files are ELF headers
only, not loadable Node modules; nothing in the archive is runnable code.

## Generator and commands

Generated on 2026-10-13, macOS 27.2 AArch64, with `asar` v4.1.0
(`@electron/asar`, run by Node.js v25.8.1), and regenerated byte-identically
the same day:

```sh
tests/fixtures/appbundle/generate.sh tests/fixtures/appbundle
```

The script builds the tree in a temporary directory and runs
`asar pack app sample.asar --unpack '*.txt'`. The `sample.asar.unpacked`
directory that `asar` also writes is not kept.
